packages.title: Pure core: detectors, geometry, state, overlay, params
packages.summary: SPEC §4.1–4.5. src/core/types.ts and constants.ts exactly as §4.1 (harness pre-copies them); detectors.ts (5 detectors + luhnValid + mergeMatches + detect + partialRange, normative match tables), geometry.ts (rects, merge, circle hit-test, rect-local radial mask string), state.ts (clampRadius, createPrivacyState, privacyReducer, revealMode), overlay.ts (computeOverlay), params.ts (parseDemoParams). No DOM, no React, no Math.random/Date.now. Paths are relative to apps/privacy-spotlight/.

packages.title: Reusable <PrivacySpotlight> component: DOM scanner, overlay, hook
packages.summary: SPEC §4.6 and §6. scanner.ts (TreeWalker over text nodes + [data-sensitive], Range rects via injectable measure, ignore rules, owners), usePrivacySpotlight.ts, PrivacySpotlight.tsx (sibling overlay, per-rect radial mask-image, mouse + window key listeners, fail-closed scanning: useLayoutEffect on present, MutationObserver + flushSync, rAF-throttled resize/scroll/fonts), privacy-spotlight.css (solid/blur/partial, reveal-all, ring, reduced motion), index.ts barrel. Imports only src/core. Owns the masking/reveal e2e criteria (verified by the reviewer once WP-03/WP-04 land).

packages.title: Demo content: fake SaaS dashboard + toolbar
packages.summary: SPEC §4.7 and §6. data.ts with the normative fake PII strings and expected counts (35/38), Dashboard.tsx (header strip, KPI row, customers table, billing card, API keys card, support inbox with inbox-add and controlled ticket prop; every value in its own testid span; data-sensitive on names/address/note), Toolbar.tsx (presentation toggle, mode buttons, spotlight toggle, radius slider, hidden-count, reveal hint), demo.css (2-column grid, no inner scrollers, mono tokens). Uses only types/constants from src/core (pre-copied by harness), never the spotlight component.

packages.title: Tour scenario + page integration + README
packages.summary: SPEC §4.8, §4.9, §7 and §10. src/scenario/tour.ts (TOUR_BEATS, TOUR_CURSOR, createTour via @jib/demo-kit, easeInOut, cursorAt); src/components/DemoApp.tsx (controller from params, Toolbar + PrivacySpotlight + Dashboard, ticket state, hidden count) and TourDriver.tsx (useScenarioPlayer + ScenarioControls, sync patches, ghost cursor, pointer dispatch inside privacy-root only); app/page.tsx (DemoShell, badge, threat-note footer, parseDemoParams); README.md (usage, threat model, limitations, recording steps). Builds against the WP-02 contract stubs; page e2e verified by the reviewer.
